history.title: Consent history
history.description: Every change to this customer's marketing and privacy choices, newest first. Entries are never edited or removed.
history.loadFailed: We could not load the consent history. Please try again.
history.ipMasked: IP addresses are partly hidden for your role.

card.title: Privacy
card.description: Tools for this customer's personal data. Each use is written to the audit log, without the personal data itself.
card.anonymisedNote: This customer is anonymised. Export and anonymise are no longer available.

export.help: Download everything held about this customer as a JSON file.
export.title: Export customer data?
export.description: The file contains personal data: profile, addresses, orders, messages, sign-ins and consent history. Keep it safe and share it only with the customer. Every export is logged under your name.
export.limit: You have reached the limit of 10 exports per hour. Try again later.

anonymise.help: Permanently replace this customer's personal details. This cannot be undone.
anonymise.title: Anonymise this customer?
anonymise.irreversible: This cannot be undone. The person's details are replaced for good and the customer can no longer sign in with this account.

replaced.profile: Name, mobile number and email of the customer
replaced.orders: Contact and delivery details on orders, shipments and returns
replaced.text: Free text on tickets, contact messages, notes and notification logs
replaced.signins: Sign-in details and the IP address of consent records
replaced.audit: Old and new values in the audit trail of this person's records

kept.invoices: Invoices and credit notes exactly as issued, including the buyer details printed on them
kept.orders: Order totals, taxes, items and status history
kept.money: Payments, refunds and stock movements: amounts and dates
kept.audit: Who did what and when, in the audit trail

anonymise.keptSummary: Invoices and order totals are kept for the books.
anonymise.balances: Loyalty points and store credit stay on the closed account and cannot be used.
anonymise.again: The same mobile number can sign in again, as a new customer.
anonymise.reasonHint: Why is this being done? It is written to the audit log. 5 to 300 characters.
anonymise.confirmLabel: Type the customer id to confirm
anonymise.confirmWrong: This is not the id of this customer.
anonymise.blockedTitle: This customer cannot be anonymised yet
anonymise.blockedOpen: Finish or cancel the open work first, then try again.
anonymise.blockedStaff: This is a staff account. Staff are deactivated in the user screen.
anonymise.doneBody: {orders} orders, {returns} returns and {tickets} tickets were cleaned of personal details.
anonymise.forfeited: {points} points and {credit} store credit stay on the closed account.
anonymise.alreadyBody: This customer was anonymised before. Nothing was changed.
anonymise.failed: We could not anonymise this customer. Nothing was changed.

banner.title: Anonymised on {date}
banner.body: Personal details were replaced and the customer cannot sign in. Orders and invoices are kept for the books.
